listing_card.description: The objective of YUG Foundation is to empower women through education and access to sanitary wear to reach their full potential . This will help reduce absenteeism and dropout rates of school in Pune municipal Corporation , Pune Cantonment Board, Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation schools

The campaign also creates an environment where children can learn, grow and develop their skills. The campaign aims to enhance the schooling experience of underprivileged children by strengthening their intellectual capabilities and competencies. The campaign also works towards training them to become socially responsible citizens of India. You can support this campaign by donating on their website or contacting them on their social media handles. #GiveHerConfidence District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra GiveHerConfidence is a campaign by YUG Foundation that provides a year’s supply of sanitary napkins free of cost to each beneficiary, along with menstrual hygiene awareness sessions. The campaign aims to empower girls and women by improving their health, well-being, and confidence. The campaign also challenges the social stigma and myths that surround menstruation in India. The impact of the GiveherConfidence campaign is significant and positive, as it has reached over 22,000 girls through menstrual hygiene campaigns in the last five years and distributed an impressive 20 lakh sanitary pads to enhance women’s health and well-being. The campaign has also improved the self-esteem and life skills of the beneficiaries, enabling them to make informed choices and decisions on their reproductive health. #BhukMuktPune District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra BhukMuktPune is a campaign by YUG Foundation that aims to donate free meals to the needy and distribute food grains across the city. The campaign was launched in response to the hunger crisis caused by the coronavirus pandemic and the lockdown measures. The campaign has benefited over 22,000 families with ration kits and cooked food distribution.
